summary: T1 item 8: measurements/characterization.md is the one aggregated, current, per-spec-row rollup for this block, and it names the sim/<slug>/records/ (or layout/ldo-core/reports/) evidence record behind every verdict. It is generated by measurements/build_characterization_report.py, never hand-edited, byte-reproducible against an unchanged tree, and carries a --check mode that fails when it has drifted from the evidence it cites. Item 8 asks for that aggregation artifact to exist and be current -- it does NOT ask for every row in it to pass, and this pass verdict must not be read as if it did: the report currently reads FAIL on 7 of the 12 rows that carry a graded verdict (Dropout, Line regulation, Load regulation, Load transient, PSRR, Iq, Stability), PASS on 5 (Output, Current limit, Startup/soft-start, Enable/shutdown, Thermal), and N/A on 4 further rows. Output moved FAIL -> PASS with issue #164: no ratified bound was touched and the DUT is unchanged -- only the mc-output-accuracy bench's initial-condition contract, see design/README.md "#164". Thermal moved FAIL -> PASS with issue #189, on the same footing: no ratified bound was touched and the DUT is unchanged -- one value in the sim/thermal bench's `.nodeset` seed card (EA_TAIL) was written as if it tracked VIN when a three-supply measurement puts its supply slope at 0.24 V/V, which is what left two corners tripping the #171 solver-diagnostic gate in the superseded record; correcting it takes the bench to 15/15 PASS with zero solver diagnostics. See sim/README.md "#189". Those FAILs are item 5's subject matter and item 5 is unmet here. See signoff/README.md for the full reading.
